mapper.select: select u.id, u.name, u.nickname, u.phone_number, u.gender, u.birth, u.point, n.head, n.top, n.bottom, n.shoes from user_tb as u join now_avatar_tb as n on u.id = n.user_id where u.id = #{userId}
select i.user_id, i.avatar_id, a.name, a.type from inventory_tb as i join avatar_tb as a on i.avatar_id = a.id where i.user_id = #{userId}
select f.friend_id, u.name as friendName, u.gender from friend_tb as f join user_tb as u on f.friend_id = u.id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by u.online_status desc

select f.friend_id, u.name as friendName, u.gender from friend_tb as f join user_tb as u on f.friend_id = u.id where f.user_id = #{userId} and (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) order by u.online_status desc

select u.id as friendId, u.name as friendName, u.gender from user_tb as u where u.id != #{userId} and u.id not in ( select f.friend_id from friend_tb as f where f.user_id = #{userId} ) and ( (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) or (u.elementary_school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) or (u.middle_school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) or (u.high_school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) )
select fw.sender_id , u.name from friend_wait_tb as fw join user_tb as u on fw.sender_id = u.id where fw.receiver_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from friend_wait_tb where sender_id = #{receiverId} and receiver_id = #{senderId}
mapper.select: select fw.receiver_id , u.name from friend_wait_tb as fw join user_tb as u on fw.receiver_id = u.id where fw.sender_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from friend_tb where friend_id = #{friendId} and user_id = #{userId}
